title: Never expose authentication credentials in logs
incident_summary: Authorization headers appeared in application logs during a production authentication path and were later copied into monitoring output.
invariant: Credential material must never reach application logs, including authorization headers, access tokens and API keys.
rationale: Logs are broadly readable, retained for long periods and forwarded to third-party monitoring systems. A credential in a log is indistinguishable from a credential leak.
remediation: Delete the credential from the log call; use an actor ID, request correlation ID or a redacted value such as logged_by: user.id.
origin: INC-014: auth headers in app logs, 2026-09-14
